title: Firefox 160 Changes How People View and Access Web Content

sources.name: Mozilla Firefox
sources.title: Firefox 160.0, See All New Features, Updates and Fixes

sources.name: Mozilla Connect — Mozilla employee asafko (Ania)
sources.title: Mini Window beta is going live in Firefox 160 and we want your feedback

paragraphs.en: Firefox 160 reached desktop release users
paragraphs.zh: Firefox 160開始向桌面正式版使用者提供，

paragraphs.en: on November 10, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 日期為2026年11月10日。

paragraphs.en: Mozilla's release notes describe changes
paragraphs.zh: Mozilla的版本說明介紹了多項變更，

paragraphs.en: to viewing windows, video controls, and saved documents.
paragraphs.zh: 涵蓋檢視視窗、影片控制與儲存的文件。

paragraphs.en: Among them is Mini Window,
paragraphs.zh: 其中包括迷你視窗功能，

paragraphs.en: an early feature that changes
paragraphs.zh: 這項初期功能改變了

paragraphs.en: how a browser can keep information in view.
paragraphs.zh: 瀏覽器持續顯示資訊的方式。

paragraphs.en: Mini Window allows a complete tab
paragraphs.zh: 迷你視窗可將完整分頁

paragraphs.en: or a selected section of a page
paragraphs.zh: 或網頁上選定的區域

paragraphs.en: to move into a compact window.
paragraphs.zh: 移入小型視窗。

paragraphs.en: That window stays above other windows while browsing.
paragraphs.zh: 瀏覽時，這個視窗會保持在其他視窗上方。

paragraphs.en: In an October 19 introduction on Mozilla Connect,
paragraphs.zh: 在10月19日發布於Mozilla Connect的介紹中，

paragraphs.en: a Mozilla employee explained that the idea
paragraphs.zh: 一位Mozilla員工說明，這個構想

paragraphs.en: extends the familiar Picture-in-Picture pattern beyond video.
paragraphs.zh: 將熟悉的子母畫面模式擴展至影片以外的內容。

paragraphs.en: The employee's explanation gives an important detail:
paragraphs.zh: 該員工的說明提供了一項重要細節：

paragraphs.en: when a tab or section moves,
paragraphs.zh: 當分頁或區域被移出時，

paragraphs.en: it is no longer accessible in the regular window.
paragraphs.zh: 使用者便無法再從原本視窗存取它。

paragraphs.en: Users can send it back
paragraphs.zh: 使用者可以將它送回原處，

paragraphs.en: from the Mini Window.
paragraphs.zh: 操作位置就在迷你視窗中。

paragraphs.en: This describes moving a view between windows,
paragraphs.zh: 這描述的是將檢視內容移至不同視窗，

paragraphs.en: rather than creating an independent copy
paragraphs.zh: 而不是建立一份獨立副本，

paragraphs.en: that can be edited separately.
paragraphs.zh: 讓使用者分開編輯。

paragraphs.en: Video viewing receives a different improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 影片觀看則獲得另一項改進。

paragraphs.en: The Picture-in-Picture player now offers playback speeds
paragraphs.zh: 子母畫面播放器現在提供播放速度選項，

paragraphs.en: from one quarter of normal speed
paragraphs.zh: 範圍從正常速度的四分之一

paragraphs.en: to twice normal speed.
paragraphs.zh: 到正常速度的兩倍。

paragraphs.en: According to the release notes,
paragraphs.zh: 根據版本說明，

paragraphs.en: the speed setting appears only
paragraphs.zh: 速度設定只會出現在

paragraphs.en: when the player is medium-sized or larger.
paragraphs.zh: 中型或更大的播放器視窗中。

paragraphs.en: A control's availability can therefore depend
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一個控制項是否顯示，可能取決於

paragraphs.en: on the size of its window.
paragraphs.zh: 所處視窗的大小。

paragraphs.en: Another change concerns pages saved as PDF.
paragraphs.zh: 另一項變更涉及儲存為PDF的網頁。

paragraphs.en: Firefox's notes say mathematical content written in MathML
paragraphs.zh: Firefox的說明指出，以MathML編寫的數學內容

paragraphs.en: is now accessible to assistive technology
paragraphs.zh: 現在可供輔助科技存取，

paragraphs.en: such as screen readers in those documents.
paragraphs.zh: 例如螢幕閱讀器可讀取這些文件中的內容。

paragraphs.en: This is a specific improvement for mathematical content,
paragraphs.zh: 這是針對數學內容的特定改進，

paragraphs.en: not a claim that every possible document
paragraphs.zh: 並非宣稱所有可能的文件

paragraphs.en: will work perfectly with every reading tool.
paragraphs.zh: 都能與每一種閱讀工具完美搭配。

paragraphs.en: MDN's technical documentation explains the background.
paragraphs.zh: MDN的技術文件說明了相關背景。

paragraphs.en: MathML is a markup language
paragraphs.zh: MathML是一種標記語言，

paragraphs.en: for describing mathematical notation.
paragraphs.zh: 用來描述數學符號表示法。

paragraphs.en: Its learning materials include structured formulas,
paragraphs.zh: 相關學習材料涵蓋結構化公式，

paragraphs.en: with elements for fractions and roots.
paragraphs.zh: 並包含表示分數與根式的元素。

paragraphs.en: That context helps explain why saving a page
paragraphs.zh: 這個背景有助於說明，為何儲存網頁時

paragraphs.en: can involve more than preserving
paragraphs.zh: 不只涉及保留

paragraphs.en: what appears on the screen.
paragraphs.zh: 畫面上看得到的內容。

paragraphs.en: The release also changes some smaller interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 這次更新也調整了一些較小的操作細節。

paragraphs.en: History entries can be dragged
paragraphs.zh: 使用者可以拖曳歷史紀錄項目，

paragraphs.en: from the sidebar to the tab strip
paragraphs.zh: 從側邊欄移到分頁列，

paragraphs.en: to open new tabs.
paragraphs.zh: 藉此開啟新分頁。

paragraphs.en: Mozilla also reports stronger visual contrast
paragraphs.zh: Mozilla也表示，網址列中的視覺對比已提高，

paragraphs.en: between a site's domain name
paragraphs.zh: 這項對比位於網站網域名稱

paragraphs.en: and the rest of its address.
paragraphs.zh: 與網址其餘部分之間。

paragraphs.en: These adjustments affect navigation and recognition,
paragraphs.zh: 這些調整影響導覽與辨識，

paragraphs.en: even though they are less visible than a new window feature.
paragraphs.zh: 即使它們不像新視窗功能那麼顯眼。

paragraphs.en: Together, these changes illustrate
paragraphs.zh: 綜合來看，這些變更展現了

paragraphs.en: several dimensions of browser development.
paragraphs.zh: 瀏覽器開發的多個面向。

paragraphs.en: Mini Window concerns how information is arranged,
paragraphs.zh: 迷你視窗關係到資訊如何排列，

paragraphs.en: video controls concern how it is experienced,
paragraphs.zh: 影片控制關係到資訊的觀看體驗，

paragraphs.en: and the PDF change concerns who can access it.
paragraphs.zh: PDF的變更則關係到誰能存取內容。

paragraphs.en: Mozilla describes Mini Window as an early version
paragraphs.zh: Mozilla將迷你視窗稱為初期版本，

paragraphs.en: and asks for feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 並邀請使用者提供意見。

paragraphs.en: The release therefore combines new capabilities
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這次更新同時提供新能力，

paragraphs.en: with work that remains open to refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 也保留了持續改善的空間。

paragraphs.en: These are desktop changes described in Mozilla's announcement.
paragraphs.zh: 這些都是Mozilla公告中介紹的桌面版變更。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the article?

choices.text: Firefox 160 focuses only on changing video speed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。影片速度只是其中一項，文章也討論迷你視窗、PDF數學內容的存取與導覽細節。

choices.text: Firefox 160 removes the need for reading tools and browser tabs.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段說改進對輔助科技的支援，第七段仍討論開啟新分頁，並未移除這些工具。

choices.text: Firefox 160 includes changes to window organisation, media controls, and content access.
choices.explanation: 正確。第一段列出更新範圍，第八段總結資訊排列、觀看體驗及內容存取等不同面向。

choices.text: Every new Firefox feature is described as complete and needing no further feedback.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第八段指出迷你視窗仍是初期版本，Mozilla邀請使用者提供意見。

quiz.explanation: 主旨應涵蓋文章介紹的多項更新，而不能只抓住影片速度或迷你視窗。第一段概述三種變更，第八段再總結其不同用途，因此第三個選項最完整。

evidence.quote: Mozilla's release notes describe changes to viewing windows, video controls, and saved documents.
Mini Window concerns how information is arranged, video controls concern how it is experienced, and the PDF change concerns who can access it.

quiz.question: What should a user understand when moving a tab into Mini Window?

choices.text: The same content becomes unavailable in the regular window until it is sent back.
choices.explanation: 正確。第三段說內容移入迷你視窗後，原本視窗不再可存取，並可由迷你視窗送回。

choices.text: The browser creates a second copy that can be edited independently.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段明確區分移動檢視內容與建立可獨立編輯的副本。

choices.text: The content is permanently deleted from the browser.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。內容移到另一個視窗，使用者仍可送回，並非永久刪除。

choices.text: Only video content can be moved.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第二段說功能支援完整分頁或選定區域，並將子母畫面模式擴展至影片以外的內容。

quiz.explanation: 應將第二段的功能範圍與第三段的行為一起理解：這是移動分頁或區域，而非複製或刪除。第三段直接說原本視窗不再可存取該內容，直到使用者將它送回。

evidence.quote: The employee's explanation gives an important detail: when a tab or section moves, it is no longer accessible in the regular window. Users can send it back from the Mini Window.

quiz.question: What is the most reasonable conclusion about the PDF improvement?

choices.text: Every kind of PDF now works perfectly with every reading tool.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段明確說這並非對所有文件與閱讀工具的全面保證。

choices.text: Making mathematical content accessible can involve more than preserving its visual appearance.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段說明MathML內容對輔助科技的支援，第六段解釋結構化數學表示法，並指出儲存不只涉及畫面外觀。

choices.text: MathML is a video format used to control playback speed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段說MathML用來描述數學表示法，影片速度則是第四段的另一項功能。

choices.text: The change affects only the size of the Picture-in-Picture window.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。視窗大小限制屬於第四段的速度設定；PDF改進關乎數學內容及輔助科技。

quiz.explanation: 第五與第六段連結了輔助科技存取與數學內容的結構。這支持「可讀取內容不只是外觀」的推論，但不能擴大為所有PDF都已完美無障礙。

evidence.quote: Firefox's notes say mathematical content written in MathML is now accessible to assistive technology such as screen readers in those documents.
That context helps explain why saving a page can involve more than preserving what appears on the screen.
